exchangeability_assumptions_and_limitati: Split conformal inference guarantees marginal coverage under exchangeability (i.i.d.) between calibration and test data. In non-stationary hydrological systems subject to decadal rainfall trends and deepening groundwater draft, future coverage may deviate from nominal 90% if exchangeability is violated. Reported empirical coverage reflects performance on the 2023–2025 test holdout.
note: Calibrated on distinct temporal calibration holdout (2020, 2022) of selected Linear Regression model. Evaluated on unseen 2023–2025 test holdout.
